items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Getting poked out. Sell it when slots fill.

items.name: Grit
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-8,000 (levels 1-14). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Ground Strike T3, Death Slam unlocked. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Cold Front. Ultimate (Death Slam) is available from Improved Spirit.

items.name: Headshot Booster
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Headhunter, 16000 souls (~16.0 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 8.5 to Flog's damage (0.85x scaling).
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Cold Front completes 4.8k spirit in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Cold Front completes 3,200 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Cold Front completes 4.8k spirit in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Cold Front completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Cold Front completes 4.8k spirit in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 17.5 to Death Slam's impact damage (0.97x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Cold Front
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power.

items.name: Mystic Shot
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Headhunter, 9600 souls (~9.6 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Stamina
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Stamina Mastery, 4000 souls (~4.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 8,000-27,200 (levels 14-29). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Flog T3, Death Slam T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Flog, damage) grows from 132 to 269. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Stamina Mastery, weapon 4.8k at Headhunter.

items.name: Enchanter's Emblem
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Stamina Mastery completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Stamina Mastery completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Stamina Mastery
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Extra Stamina (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.caption: Takes spirit from 4,800 to 7,200 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power. From Flog T3: first ability hit above its 165-damage trigger (nothing clears it at this purchase). Upgrade of Mystic Burst (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.
items.why: payoff Flog T3 in 3000 souls (~3.0 min)

items.name: Headhunter
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 46% weapon damage. Upgrade of Headshot Booster (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Grapple (1 to 2). Temporary, sold when you buy Mystic Reverb later.
items.legacy_note: A second grapple gets you higher before the slam, and the higher you drop from the harder it hits.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Ground Strike: takes 18% off its 8s base cooldown.
items.legacy_note: On Ground Strike.

items.name: Warp Stone
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 29.2 to Death Slam's impact damage (0.97x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 9,600 to 14,400 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Death Slam throw distance (26m), Death Slam impact radius (6m), Ground Strike radius (10m). Takes spirit from 14,400 to 16,800 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Expansion (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 171s; 20% off is 34.2s per full rotation.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 18,400 to 24,800 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 24,800 to 30,400 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: Sell Extra Charge for this.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Tankbuster? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Enchanter's Emblem.
sections.desc: Dying after Tankbuster? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Enchanter's Emblem.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Grapple (movement). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: Stuns and sleeps keep catching you before the slam.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Hexes and slows keep you from getting out.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming, like Bebop's hook or Apollo's ult.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry melts you as you land.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Their spirit damage keeps hitting you.

items.name: Spellbreaker
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Big spirit bursts catch you as you land.

items.name: Ethereal Shift
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)
items.legacy_note: They burst you the second you land. Sell Cold Front for this.

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 8,000 to 12,800 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Sell Enchanter's Emblem for this.

items.name: Arctic Blast
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Cold Front for 4,800 more souls: damage 95 to 175; tech resist 6 to 10..
items.legacy_note: Upgrade of Cold Front.

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 8,000 to 11,200 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Sell Warp Stone for this.

items.name: Lightning Scroll
items.caption: Death Slam deals damage (impact damage), so it applies the item's 0.75s stun after a 3s delay plus 150 damage. Replaces Greater Expansion: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: Sell Greater Expansion for this.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 171s of base cooldown across your kit, 135s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Replaces Tankbuster: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: Sell Tankbuster for this.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
items.legacy_note: Upgrade of Superior Cooldown.

items.name: Majestic Leap
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Instead of Warp Stone. Leap up, then Ground Strike from the top for a bigger slam.
